A rare diamond discovered in the historic Golconda mines of Hyderabad is set to dazzle at an upcoming international auction in Geneva, Switzerland. Ahead of the auction, a 24-carat rare pink diamond from the legendary Golconda mines has been put on display, alongside a large blue sapphire belonging to the Russian royal family. These historically significant gemstones are estimated to be worth hundreds of crores of rupees, drawing significant attention from collectors and enthusiasts worldwide.

recentItems.description:
Chinese scientists have achieved a historic milestone in space research by setting a new world record for the lowest temperature ever recorded in human history. As part of an experiment conducted aboard China's own space station, researchers successfully cooled rubidium atoms to an astonishing 9.7 picokelvin. This groundbreaking achievement has sent shockwaves through the global scientific community, marking a significant leap forward in low-temperature physics and space-based experimentation.
